events.title: 스코틀랜드 모팟에서 태어나다
events.description: 스코틀랜드 모팟에서 태어났다. 윈체스터 칼리지와 왕립군사학교 울리치를 거쳐 육군에 들어갔다.
events.description_en: He was born in Moffat, Scotland. He attended Winchester College and the Royal Military Academy at Woolwich before entering the army.

events.title: 왕립수비포병대 장교로 임관하다
events.title_en: He was commissioned into the Royal Garrison Artillery
events.description: 왕립수비포병대 소위로 임관해 지브롤터, 실론, 홍콩을 거쳐 인도의 산악포병중대에서 복무했다.
events.description_en: He was commissioned as a subaltern in the Royal Garrison Artillery, serving in Gibraltar, Ceylon, and Hong Kong before joining a mountain artillery battery in India.

events.title: 비행을 배워 조종사 자격을 따다
events.title_en: He learned to fly and earned his pilot's wings
events.description: 브루클랜즈의 비행학교에서 비행을 배우고 국제항공연맹 조종사 자격을 땄다. 이듬해 중앙비행학교를 마치고 날개 휘장을 받았다.
events.description_en: He learned to fly at the flying school in Brooklands and earned his international pilot's certificate. The following year he finished the Central Flying School and received his wings.

events.title: 왕립비행대 조종사로 전선에 나가다
events.title_en: He flew to the front as an RFC pilot
events.description: 왕립비행대 제7비행대대 조종사로 프랑스 전선에 배치됐다. 이듬해 제16비행대대 지휘관이 되었다.
events.description_en: He was posted to the front in France as a pilot with No. 7 Squadron, Royal Flying Corps. The following year he took command of No. 16 Squadron.

events.title: 트렌처드와 조종사 피로 문제로 부딪히다
events.title_en: He clashed with Trenchard over exhausted pilots
events.description: 솜 전투 뒤 지친 조종사들을 쉬게 해야 한다고 왕립비행대 사령관 트렌처드에게 맞섰다. 이 갈등으로 프랑스 전선에서 소환됐다.
events.description_en: After the Battle of the Somme he clashed with RFC commander Hugh Trenchard, arguing that exhausted pilots needed rest. The dispute led to his recall from the French front.

events.title: 공군위원회 보급·연구담당관이 되다
events.title_en: He became Air Member for Supply and Research
events.description: 공군위원회에서 보급과 연구를 맡아 신형 전투기와 초기 레이더 개발에 예산을 붙였다. 스피트파이어와 허리케인, 레이더 실험국이 이 시기에 힘을 받았다.
events.description_en: As Air Member for Supply and Research on the Air Council, he channeled funding into new fighter designs and early radar research. The Spitfire, the Hurricane, and the first experimental radar stations all gained ground during this period.

events.title: 전투기사령부 최고사령관이 되다
events.title_en: He became Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of Fighter Command
events.description: 신설된 전투기사령부의 최고사령관을 맡았다. 레이더망과 지상 관측소, 무선 통제를 하나로 엮은 방공 체계를 이곳에서 세웠다.
events.description_en: He took command of the newly formed RAF Fighter Command. There he built an air-defense system that wove together the radar network, ground observers, and radio control into a single whole.

events.title: 본토 항공전에서 예비 전력을 아끼며 버티다
events.title_en: He rationed his reserves through the Battle of Britain
events.description: 독일 공군과 맞선 본토 항공전을 지휘하며 전투기 예비 전력을 함부로 쓰지 않았다. 이 신중함이 영국의 제공권 상실을 막았다.
events.description_en: He commanded the fighter defense during the Battle of Britain, refusing to spend his reserve squadrons carelessly. This caution kept the Luftwaffe from seizing control of the skies.

events.title: 지휘권을 내려놓다
events.description: 전술을 둘러싼 부하 지휘관들과의 갈등 끝에 전투기사령부 지휘권에서 물러났다. 독일이 영국 본토 상륙 작전을 접은 직후였다.
events.description_en: After conflict with subordinate commanders over tactics, he was removed from command of Fighter Command. It came just after Germany shelved its plan to invade Britain.

events.title: 공군에서 퇴역하다
events.title_en: He retired from the Royal Air Force
events.description: 지휘권을 내려놓은 뒤 미국에 파견돼 항공기 생산 문제를 다루는 임무를 거쳐 공군에서 완전히 퇴역했다.
events.description_en: After leaving his command he was sent to the United States to work on aircraft production issues before finally retiring from the Royal Air Force.

events.title: 남작 작위를 받다
events.description: 본토 항공전을 이끈 공을 인정받아 남작 작위를 받았다.
events.description_en: In recognition of his leadership during the Battle of Britain, he was raised to the peerage as a baron.

events.title: 심령주의를 다룬 책을 다섯 권 쓰다
events.title_en: He wrote five books on spiritualism
events.description: 퇴역 뒤 심령주의와 신지학에 몰두해 다섯 권의 책을 쓰고 전국을 다니며 강연했다. 「많은 저택」 등이 이 시기의 작품이다.
events.description_en: In retirement he immersed himself in spiritualism and theosophy, writing five books and lecturing across the country. Many Mansions was among the works from this period.

events.title: 여든일곱에 세상을 떠나다
events.description: 말년까지 심령주의 강연과 저술을 이어가다 여든일곱의 나이로 세상을 떠났다.
events.description_en: He kept lecturing and writing on spiritualism into his last years, and died at the age of eighty-seven.
